description: List issues in a GitHub repository.

labels.description: Filter issues by label names, as a comma-separated string.

owner.description: The owner of the repository to list issues in.

page.description: The page number of issue results to return.

perPage.description: The maximum number of issues to return per page.

repo.description: The name of the repository to list issues in.

state.description: Filter issues by state, such as 'open' or 'closed'.

name: list_issues
